criteria.text: Identifies that the Brightwater Robotics Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $8,400,000 but 10% of the $70,000,000 Purchase Price is $7,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies the threatened $2,750,000 claim by Foxley Robotics Ltd recorded in the board minutes and that it is not disclosed against the litigation warranty (Warranty 7.1), recommending a specific indemnity or price protection.
Calculates the long-stop date as 2 November 2026 (150 days after signing on 5 June 2026) and identifies that expected clearance on 16 November 2026 falls after it, recommending an extension.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $70,000,000 = $7,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $8,400,000.
Gives the long-stop period as 150 days and as the date 2 November 2026, with days remaining from 15 June 2026 (140 days).
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
